text: Transgender individuals frequently experience elevated levels of psychological distress, including anxiety and trauma-related symptoms. Gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) has been associated with improvements in mental health and quality of life; however, early biopsychological changes occurring during the initial phase of masculinizing hormone therapy remain insufficiently understood. The present exploratory longitudinal study investigated early endocrine and psychological changes in transgender individuals assigned female at birth undergoing masculinizing GAHT.
source_label: Early biopsychological changes during masculinizing gender-affirming hormone therapy in AFAB transgender individuals: a 4-month prospective study
